ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  **Executive Summary:**  Prataap Snacks Limited has issued a regulatory intimation primarily informing shareholders without registered email addresses on how to digitally access the FY2025-26 Annual Report and notice for the upcoming 17th Annual General Meeting (AGM), scheduled for September 24, 2026. Materially, the document also announces a proposed dividend of ₹0.50 per equity share for FY2025-26, with a record date of September 18, 2026, which, if approved, will result in a cash outflow from the company. No immediate red flags are present, as the communication details standard regulatory compliance and a financial distribution to shareholders.
